messages:
sam-l: Hey @tara-peopleops — need to remove my domestic partner from benefits. We just got married 2026-09-10 and I want coverage change effective 9/30. Can we backdate to 9/1 because benefits should switch after our wedding? Also what's the proof you need and how will payroll adjust premiums retro?

tara-peopleops: Congrats Sam! For marriage QLE we can process a mid-month change. Required docs: marriage certificate (scanned), updated dependent ID, and a short signed attestation. We usually allow the effective date to be the date of the qualifying event or the end of that month depending on carrier rules.

sam-l: The carrier told me they allow effective date of the event. Is backdating to 9/1 allowed if the marriage was 9/10? I need to know for FSA contribution planning.

tara-peopleops: We can only set the effective date to the event date (9/10) or end-of-month (9/30) per carrier. We cannot backdate to before the event. If you want 9/30 we can set that and payroll will apply full-month premium for September; if 9/10 we prorate from 9/10 onwards. Tell us which you prefer and upload the marriage cert to the portal.

payroll: For proration: if effective 9/10 we calculate employee share for days covered in the pay period and adjust on next payroll run. If you elect end-of-month (9/30) full September premium applies. If you need exact numbers send pay schedule and pay date.

benefits-bot: :paperclip: Ticket B-24680 created — "Marriage QLE: sam-l". Upload documents there or reply once uploaded.

linda-hr: FYI on tax/change implications: if your marital status changes for benefits, update payroll for withholding and dependents for HSA/FSA as needed. We can help with W-4 changes; ping me once the benefits change is processed.

sam-l: Uploaded marriage cert to ticket B-24680 and chose event date (9/10) effective. Thanks all.

tara-peopleops: Got it, moving to "In review". We'll set dependent termination 2026-09-10 and notify payroll to prorate. COBRA typically not applicable for a spouse/domestic partner removal due to marriage — but we will confirm with carrier.

benefits-bot: Update: Ticket B-24680 status changed to "In review" at 2412345690 by tara-peopleops.

sam-l: Thanks team! Appreciate the clarity — I'll follow up on W-4 with Linda. :thumbsup:
